text.card: A red giant 9,760 parsecs away, 15 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.22 solar masses and 15.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 5,148 K at its surface.
